title: `ZeroReserveInterestRateStrategy` returns zero rates, disabling all accrual for any reserve that uses it
impact: If governance mistakenly sets this strategy on a live reserve (it is a real, deployable contract with a valid `IPoolAddressesProvider` constructor), `calculateInterestRates` returns `(0,0,0)`. Borrowers pay no interest, suppliers earn nothing, and the reserve factor accrues nothing — an economic griefing / value-leak vector if activated on a productive asset. There is no on-chain guard preventing this.
